)

```{r pub}
library(mgcv)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gratia)

# ============================================================================
# 1. DATA PREPARATION
# ============================================================================

# Check data structure
cat("Sample size:", nrow(data_age_under5), "\n")
cat("Response variable summary:\n")
summary(data_age_under5$cases)

# Check for zeros or negatives
cat("\nZeros/negatives:", sum(data_age_under5$cases <= 0), "\n")

# Distribution check
hist(data_age_under5$cases, breaks = 50, 
     main = "Distribution of Cases (Age <5)",
     xlab = "Cases")

# Check vulnerability distribution by quantiles
quantile(data_age_under5$vulnerability, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.1))
```


```{r pub}
# ============================================================================
# 2. MODEL FITTING & SELECTION
# ============================================================================

# Fit competing models
m1_gaussian_log <- gam(
  cases ~ s(vulnerability, bs = "tp", k = 6),
  family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  data = data_age_under5,
  method = "REML"
)

m2_gamma <- gam(
  cases ~ s(vulnerability, bs = "tp", k = 6),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = data_age_under5,
  method = "REML"
)

m3_gaussian_identity <- gam(
  cases ~ s(vulnerability, bs = "tp", k = 6),
  family = gaussian(link = "identity"),
  data = data_age_under5,
  method = "REML"
)

# Model comparison
model_comparison <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Gaussian (log)", "Gamma (log)", "Gaussian (identity)"),
  AIC = c(AIC(m1_gaussian_log), AIC(m2_gamma), AIC(m3_gaussian_identity)),
  Deviance = c(deviance(m1_gaussian_log), deviance(m2_gamma), 
               deviance(m3_gaussian_identity)),
  EDF = c(sum(m1_gaussian_log$edf), sum(m2_gamma$edf), 
          sum(m3_gaussian_identity$edf))
) %>%
  arrange(AIC)

print(model_comparison)


```


```{r model selection}

# ============================================================================
# DEFINITIVE MODEL COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# DEFINITIVE MODEL COMPARISON
# ============================================================================

cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n")
cat("DEFINITIVE AIC COMPARISON\n")
cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n\n")

# Get AIC values directly
aic1 <- AIC(m1_gaussian_log)
aic2 <- AIC(m2_gamma)
aic3 <- AIC(m3_gaussian_identity)

cat("Model 1 - Gaussian (log):\n")
cat("  AIC = ", aic1, "\n")
cat("  Formula:", deparse(formula(m1_gaussian_log)), "\n")
cat("  Family:", family(m1_gaussian_log)$family, "\n")
cat("  Link:", family(m1_gaussian_log)$link, "\n\n")

cat("Model 2 - Gamma (log):\n")
cat("  AIC = ", aic2, "\n")
cat("  Formula:", deparse(formula(m2_gamma)), "\n")
cat("  Family:", family(m2_gamma)$family, "\n")
cat("  Link:", family(m2_gamma)$link, "\n\n")

cat("Model 3 - Gaussian (identity):\n")
cat("  AIC = ", aic3, "\n")
cat("  Formula:", deparse(formula(m3_gaussian_identity)), "\n")
cat("  Family:", family(m3_gaussian_identity)$family, "\n")
cat("  Link:", family(m3_gaussian_identity)$link, "\n\n")

# Create comparison table with explicit values
model_comparison_verified <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Gaussian (log)", "Gamma (log)", "Gaussian (identity)"),
  AIC = c(aic1, aic2, aic3),
  Deviance = c(deviance(m1_gaussian_log), 
               deviance(m2_gamma), 
               deviance(m3_gaussian_identity)),
  EDF = c(sum(m1_gaussian_log$edf), 
          sum(m2_gamma$edf), 
          sum(m3_gaussian_identity$edf)),
  N = c(nobs(m1_gaussian_log), 
        nobs(m2_gamma), 
        nobs(m3_gaussian_identity))
) %>%
  arrange(AIC) %>%
  mutate(
    Delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC),
    RelativeLikelihood = exp(-0.5 * Delta_AIC)
  )

print(model_comparison_verified)

# Identify winner
winner_idx <- which.min(model_comparison_verified$AIC)
cat("\n", strrep("*", 50), "\n")
cat("WINNER:", model_comparison_verified$Model[winner_idx], "\n")
cat(strrep("*", 50), "\n")
cat("AIC =", model_comparison_verified$AIC[winner_idx], "\n")
cat("Delta AIC from next best =", 
    round(model_comparison_verified$Delta_AIC[2], 2), "\n\n")

# Select best model programmatically
if(model_comparison_verified$Model[winner_idx] == "Gaussian (log)") {
  best_model <- m1_gaussian_log
  cat("Selected: m1_gaussian_log\n")
} else if(model_comparison_verified$Model[winner_idx] == "Gamma (log)") {
  best_model <- m2_gamma
  cat("Selected: m2_gamma\n")
} else {
  best_model <- m3_gaussian_identity
  cat("Selected: m3_gaussian_identity\n")
}

# Summary of best model
cat("\n", strrep("-", 70), "\n")
cat("BEST MODEL SUMMARY\n")
cat(strrep("-", 70), "\n")
summary(best_model)

# Export for reproducibility
write.csv(model_comparison_verified, 
          "Model_Comparison_Verified.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nResults exported to: Model_Comparison_Verified.csv\n")

```
```{r}

# ============================================================================
# CRITICAL DIAGNOSTICS FOR GAMMA MODEL
# ============================================================================

# 1. Check model diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
gam.check(m2_gamma)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# 2. More detailed diagnostics
library(gratia)
appraise(m2_gamma)

# 3. Check for extreme values/outliers
cat("\n=== DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
summary(data_age_under5$cases)

cat("\n=== CHECK FOR ZEROS ===\n")
cat("Number of zeros:", sum(data_age_under5$cases == 0), "\n")
cat("Proportion zeros:", mean(data_age_under5$cases == 0), "\n")

cat("\n=== CHECK FOR VERY SMALL VALUES ===\n")
cat("Values < 0.0001:", sum(data_age_under5$cases < 0.0001), "\n")
cat("Min value:", min(data_age_under5$cases), "\n")

# 4. Check residuals
cat("\n=== RESIDUAL DIAGNOSTICS ===\n")
resids <- residuals(m2_gamma, type = "deviance")
cat("Residual range:", range(resids), "\n")
cat("Residual mean:", mean(resids), "\n")
cat("Residual SD:", sd(resids), "\n")

# 5. Check fitted values
fitted_vals <- fitted(m2_gamma)
cat("\n=== FITTED VALUES ===\n")
cat("Fitted range:", range(fitted_vals), "\n")
cat("Observed range:", range(data_age_under5$cases), "\n")

# 6. Plot residuals
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

# Residuals vs fitted
plot(fitted(m2_gamma), residuals(m2_gamma, type = "deviance"),
     xlab = "Fitted values", ylab = "Deviance residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

# Q-Q plot
qqnorm(residuals(m2_gamma, type = "deviance"))
qqline(residuals(m2_gamma, type = "deviance"))

# Histogram of residuals
hist(residuals(m2_gamma, type = "deviance"), breaks = 50,
     main = "Histogram of Deviance Residuals")

# Scale-location
plot(fitted(m2_gamma), sqrt(abs(residuals(m2_gamma, type = "deviance"))),
     xlab = "Fitted values", ylab = "√|Deviance residuals|",
     main = "Scale-Location")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# 7. Check dispersion parameter
cat("\n=== DISPERSION ===\n")
cat("Scale parameter:", summary(m2_gamma)$scale, "\n")
cat("Should be around 1 for well-fitted Gamma model\n")
```

```{r pub}
# ============================================================================
# 4. IDENTIFY DATA SUPPORT RANGE
# ============================================================================

# Sample size by vulnerability bins
data_support <- data_age_under5 %>%
  mutate(vuln_bin = cut(vulnerability, 
                        breaks = seq(-3, 8, by = 0.5))) %>%
  group_by(vuln_bin) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_vuln = mean(vulnerability),
    mean_cases = mean(cases)
  ) %>%
  print()

# Define plotting range (1st-99th percentile)
vuln_limits <- quantile(data_age_under5$vulnerability, 
                        probs = c(0.01, 0.99))
cat("\nPlotting range:", vuln_limits, "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 5. PREDICTIONS
# ============================================================================

# Create prediction grid within data support
pred_data <- data.frame(
  vulnerability = seq(vuln_limits[1], vuln_limits[2], length.out = 200)
)

# Get predictions on response scale
pred_list <- predict(best_model, 
                     newdata = pred_data, 
                     se.fit = TRUE,
                     unconditional = TRUE,
                     type = "response")  # Back-transform from log scale

pred_data <- pred_data %>%
  mutate(
    fit = pred_list$fit,
    se = pred_list$se.fit,
    lower = fit - 1.96 * se,
    upper = fit + 1.96 * se
  )

# Calculate relative to mean (as shown in your plot)
mean_cases <- mean(data_age_under5$cases)

pred_data <- pred_data %>%
  mutate(
    fit_relative = fit - mean_cases,
    lower_relative = lower - mean_cases,
    upper_relative = upper - mean_cases
  )

# ============================================================================
# 6. VISUALIZATION
# ============================================================================

# Calculate data density for background
dens_data <- density(data_age_under5$vulnerability, 
                     from = vuln_limits[1], 
                     to = vuln_limits[2],
                     n = 512)

dens_df <- data.frame(x = dens_data$x, y = dens_data$y) %>%
  mutate(y_scaled = scales::rescale(y, to = c(-0.1, 0)))

# Create publication-quality plot
p <- ggplot(pred_data, aes(x = vulnerability, y = fit_relative)) +
  # Data distribution background
  geom_ribbon(data = dens_df, 
              aes(x = x, ymin = y_scaled, ymax = -0.1),
              fill = "grey70", alpha = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # Confidence interval
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_relative, ymax = upper_relative), 
              alpha = 0.3, fill = "#0072B2") +
  # Point estimate
  geom_line(color = "#0072B2", size = 1.2) +
  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey50") +
  # Annotations
  annotate("text", x = -2, y = 0.02, 
           label = "Less Vulnerable", 
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5, color = "grey30", fontface = "italic") +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.02, 
           label = "More Vulnerable", 
           hjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey30", fontface = "italic") +
  # Axes and labels
  scale_x_continuous(
    "Vulnerability (Standardized Z-Score)",
    breaks = seq(-2, 8, 2),
    limits = c(vuln_limits[1], vuln_limits[2])
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    "Change in deaths averted\n(relative to mean)",
    breaks = seq(-0.1, 0.1, 0.05)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.1, 0.1), expand = FALSE) +
  # Theme
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Age <5",
       caption = paste0("n = ", nrow(data_age_under5), 
                       "; Curves represent partial effects centered at 0"))

print(p)

# # Save high-resolution version
# ggsave("age_under5_vulnerability_analysis.pdf", 
#        plot = p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


```{r pub}
# ============================================================================
# 7. SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

# Test different basis dimensions
sensitivity_models <- list()
for(k_val in 4:8) {
  m_temp <- gam(
    cases ~ s(vulnerability, bs = "tp", k = k_val),
    family = Gamma(link = "log"),
    data = data_age_under5,
    method = "REML"
  )
  sensitivity_models[[paste0("k", k_val)]] <- m_temp
}

# Compare AICs
sens_comparison <- data.frame(
  k = 4:8,
  AIC = sapply(sensitivity_models, AIC),
  EDF = sapply(sensitivity_models, function(m) sum(m$edf))
)
print(sens_comparison)

# ============================================================================
# 8. EXPORT RESULTS FOR SUPPLEMENTARY MATERIALS
# ============================================================================

# Table S1: Sample size by vulnerability quartiles
supp_table_1 <- data_age_under5 %>%
  mutate(vuln_quartile = cut(vulnerability, 
                             breaks = quantile(vulnerability, 
                                             probs = 0:4/4),
                             include.lowest = TRUE,
                             labels = c("Q1 (Least)", "Q2", "Q3", 
                                       "Q4 (Most)"))) %>%
  group_by(vuln_quartile) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `Mean Cases` = mean(cases),
    `SD Cases` = sd(cases),
    `Mean Vulnerability` = mean(vulnerability),
    `SD Vulnerability` = sd(vulnerability)
  )

write.csv(supp_table_1, "supplementary_table_sample_sizes.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Table S2: Model comparison
write.csv(model_comparison, "supplementary_table_model_selection.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Export diagnostic plots
pdf("supplementary_diagnostics_age_under5.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
gam.check(best_model)
dev.off()

```
